theme_strategy: Retro-Terminal meets High-End Casino. A deep, archived-website feel (reminiscent of 2013-era simpledice.com) blended with modern SaaS density. We create visual tension by mixing a luxury Serif font for headings with a sterile, phosphor-glowing Monospace font for all data. Dark charcoal backgrounds, sharp edges, and 1px borders dominate the UI.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use 'Playfair Display' (Serif) ONLY for the Logo, major section headings, and marketing copy. STRICTLY use 'JetBrains Mono' (Monospace) for EVERYTHING else: body text, buttons, numerical data, balances, bet amounts, multipliers, seeds, and table contents to emulate the retro terminal gambling feel. Do NOT use Inter.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: High Density Grid (Dashboard Mode). Tight gaps (`gap-4`) for the game control panel to group related math inputs, generous padding (`p-8`) for structural containers.

grid_modes.desktop_layout: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. The chat sidebar takes `col-span-3` on the right (hidden on mobile, toggleable). The main content (Game + Tables) takes `col-span-9`.

spacing_and_layout.containers: Use sharp edges (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`). Avoid heavily rounded corners. The UI should feel like a rigid, structural terminal.

surface_styles.cards_and_panels: Flat Solid surfaces (`bg-[#18181b]`) with a 1px border (`border-[#27272a]`). No soft drop shadows. Focus on optical clarity.
surface_styles.header: Solid Background (`bg-[#09090b]`) with a hard bottom border. Do not use glassmorphism.
surface_styles.inputs_and_controls: Terminal inputs: flat dark background (`bg-[#121214]`), sharp 1px border. Focus state must use a high-contrast phosphor green ring (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4ade80]`).

buttons.primary: Sharp rectangle. Background `#4ade80`, text `#000000`, `font-bold`, uppercase monospace. Hover state: slightly lighter green, `-translate-y-[1px]`.
buttons.secondary: Outline style with monospace text, `#a1a1aa` text that turns white on hover.

component_guidelines.tables: Dense rows (`py-2`). Numbers MUST be right-aligned for easy magnitude comparison. Use `JetBrains Mono` exclusively. Alternating row backgrounds (`bg-[#18181b]` / `bg-[#121214]`).
component_guidelines.dice_slider: Custom styled HTML range input. The track should visually map the win/loss chance (e.g., green segment for win range, red segment for loss).
component_guidelines.chat_sidebar: Fixed width to the right. Minimalist message bubbles (just plain text rows, no chat-bubble tails), with timestamps in small monospace.
component_guidelines.provably_fair_panel: Dense, terminal-style panel below the game. Display Server Seed, Client Seed, and Nonce in raw monospace formats.

animation_and_motion.dice_roll: Rapidly cycling numbers (using JetBrains Mono) with a slight blur/glitch effect for a few milliseconds, resolving sharply to the final result.
animation_and_motion.live_feed: New rows in the 'All Bets' table should briefly flash green (win) or red (loss) for 500ms when they appear, then fade to the default row background.
animation_and_motion.hover_states: Crisp, instantaneous color transitions. No slow fades for structural elements.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use icons sparingly. Rely on typography and symbols (like '₿' or '$') over icons to maintain the archived text-heavy look.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure green (`#4ade80`) and amber (`#fbbf24`) pass APCA contrast against the `#09090b` background.
accessibility.focus: All inputs, buttons, and sliders MUST have visible focus rings.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: Apply `data-testid` to Roll button, Bet inputs, Chat input, Tab triggers, and Table rows for test automation.

home_dashboard.top_nav: Logo ('Playfair Display'), Balances Dropdown, Faucet Button, User Profile/Login.

main_area.hero_game_panel: Dice interface. Big display for the 'Rolled' result. Over/Under toggle. Slider for chance. Number inputs for Bet Size, Payout, Win Chance. Huge 'ROLL DICE' button.
main_area.tables_section: Tabs: All Bets, High Rollers, My Bets. Live updating table.

home_dashboard.right_sidebar: Live Chat. Header with online count. Message list. Input area at bottom.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do NOT center align the main app container. Left-align dense content and structure with grids.
NEVER use Inter font. Strictly adhere to Playfair Display for headings and JetBrains Mono for everything else.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='roll-button'`, `data-testid='bet-input'`).
Ensure table columns containing numbers (Bet, Payout, Profit) are right-aligned to allow users to easily compare magnitudes.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath; use solid colors to ensure legibility.
When customizing Shadcn components, override border-radius classes to `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` to fit the retro brutalist theme.
Create depth through 1px borders and distinct dark background shades, avoiding soft drop shadows.
